when a rotating gaseous mass gradually
contracts.

repulsion has already been lost to space.

The Terrestrial Motion Budget
On Earth, gravity (Attraction) dominates. Raising a weight requires an
artificial injection of Repulsion (human or steam power).
Output: Molecular Repulsion
Motion is not destroyed. The mechanical
repulsion is transformed into molecular
repulsion (frictional heat and sound) as the
gears turn and the weight strikes the floor.
Input: Artificial Repulsion
A human arm winds a grandfather clock,
mechanically raising the weight.
Gravity (Attraction)
Action: Attraction Taking Over
The weight falls. The operative capacity is
exhausted as it complies with the pull of
gravity.
